note: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India. Population Census 2011, Table A-01 (reference date 1 March 2011), persons. Re-cut to today's states with 2011 district counts: Telangana = ten districts of 2011 Andhra Pradesh (Adilabad … Khammam; the official post-2014 figure is 35.0 m because seven Khammam mandals went to Andhra Pradesh), Ladakh = Leh + Kargil, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu merged. Jammu & Kashmir counts exclude areas not administered by India. 'world' holds the India total.
